author: roma
notes: Two routes read from the map's teleport names (chk-maps run 73). From the spawn room a short jump yard (pits to j1/j2) leads to two holes: one to pro1, the hard route (pro1..pro4), whose last door sends to map_finish; the other to noob1, the easy route (noob1..noob5, noob_52), whose last door sends to noob_finish, a room with doors on to pro1 and back to j3. The main track is the pro route, from the spawn room's exit (start box behind the jump yard's damage-filter wall, round j1) to the door into map_finish; the easy route is bonus 1, from noob1 to the door into noob_finish. The map_finish room also has a door to noob_finish; the bonus end is the one at the end of the easy route, picked by position. Not published.
